title: Revenue Opportunity Diagnostic
subtitle: Discover where revenue is leaking and what to fix first

areas.label: Lead Generation
areas.question: How consistently do you generate qualified leads from your target market?
areas.description: Inbound interest, referrals, trade shows, digital channels

areas.label: Sales Process
areas.question: How predictable and repeatable is your sales process?
areas.description: Pipeline stages, win rates, sales cycle length

areas.label: Follow-up Speed
areas.question: How quickly does your team follow up on new opportunities?
areas.description: Response time to inquiries, quotes, and RFQs

areas.label: Quoting & Proposals
areas.question: How efficient is your quoting and proposal process?
areas.description: Time to quote, accuracy, win rate on submitted bids

areas.label: Operations
areas.question: How well do your operations support revenue delivery?
areas.description: Handoffs between sales and ops, fulfillment, quality

areas.label: Reporting & Visibility
areas.question: How quickly can leadership see revenue and operational performance?

areas.label: Customer Retention
areas.question: How proactively do you retain and expand existing customers?
areas.description: Renewals, upsells, churn signals, account management

areas.label: Data & Systems
areas.question: How connected are your business systems and data?
areas.description: CRM, ERP, spreadsheets, email — single source of truth

areas.label: Automation & AI
areas.question: How mature is your automation and AI readiness?
areas.description: Manual tasks, workflow automation, AI pilot status
